articles.title: Arla lägger ned Falbygdens ost
articles.summary: Nyheter från TV4: Arla lägger ned Falbygdens ost
articles.body_text: Falbygdens ost läggs ned av Arla. Arkivbild. Falbygdens ost i Falköping läggs ned av Arla, som äger företaget. Totalt kommer omkring 60 tjänster att försvinna, skriver Arla i ett pressmeddelande. Verksamheten har länge dragits med dålig lönsamhet, enligt Arla, som köpte Falbygdens ost av finska Atria 2014. Företaget bedriver ingen egen osttillverkning och använder inte mjölk från Arlabönder utan bygger sin verksamhet på import, lagring, förädling och paketering av special- och dessertostar. ”Det är ett tungt besked både för våra medarbetare och för lokalsamhället i Falköping. Vi har stor respekt för Falbygdens osts långa historia och för de människor som berörs av beslutet”, säger Anna Schreil, chef för Arlas logistik och produktion. Några av dessertostarna förs över till varumärket Castello. De lagrade svenska ostklassikerna lever vidare under varumärket Kvibille.

articles.title: Kvargboomen får mejerierna att investera hundratals miljoner
articles.summary: Tror att trenden kommit för att stanna
articles.body_text: Kvargboomen får mejerierna att investera hundratals miljoner Efterfrågan på kvarg har ökat kraftigt de senaste åren. Nu investerar svenska mejerier närmare en halv miljard kronor för att kunna möta den växande efterfrågan. På gymmet i Umeå är kvarg en del av kosten för flera av dem som tränar regelbundet. – Jag äter extra protein både för att jag tränar och för att man behöver extra protein när man blir äldre, säger Linda Vidström Lundmark. Försäljningen av kvarg har skjutit i höjden de senaste åren. Mellan september 2025 och september 2026 ökade försäljningen med 28 procent, enligt analysföretaget Nielsen IQ. – Den har ju gått från stark till nästan kaotisk den senaste perioden. Vi har helt klart märkt hur den har slagit i taket, säger Johan Westerlund, affärsutvecklare på Norrmejerier i Umeå. Den ökade efterfrågan märks nu också i mejeriernas investeringar. Arla Foods satsar 380 miljoner kronor på ökad kvargproduktion och ytterligare 310 miljoner på att tillverka mer keso. Skånemejerier investerar 70 miljoner kronor i kvargproduktion. Och på Norrmejerier i Umeå satsas 50 miljoner kronor på en ny metod som ska göra det möjligt att öka kvargproduktionen i den befintliga anläggningen. Allt är inte klart men i nya rör flyter proteinet – den viktiga beståndsdelen i kvarg. Den växande efterfrågan drivs bland annat av intresset för protein och produkter med lågt fettinnehåll. Kvarg har blivit populärt bland personer som tränar, personer som använder viktminskningsläkemedel och äldre som vill bevara muskelmassa. Men behöver unga som tränar verkligen äta stora mängder kvarg för att få i sig tillräckligt med protein? – De flesta som tränar täcker sitt proteinbehov med den vanliga maten. Man behöver inte äta extra kvarg av den anledningen, säger David Jonsson, universitetsadjunkt på institutionen för kost- och måltidsvetenskap vid Umeå universitet. Samtidigt kan kvarg vara ett enkelt sätt att få i sig mer protein för den som faktiskt har ett högre behov.

articles.title: Utlyser nyval i Spanien efter bostadskrisen
articles.summary: Nyheter från TV4: Utlyser nyval i Spanien efter bostadskrisen
articles.body_text: Utlyser nyval i Spanien efter bostadskrisen Spaniens premiärminister Pedro Sánchez utlyser nyval sedan hans regering inte fått igenom sina förslag om nya åtgärder för att lösa landets bostadskris. Nyvalet ska hållas den 29 november. Beslutet att utlysa nyval meddelas under ett tv-sänt tal på måndagsmorgonen. Bostadspaketet, i huvudsak bestående av två olika lagar, lades fram efter det att en 87-årig kvinna vräktes från sin lägenhet i Madrid – vilket har fått spanjorernas ilska över bostadskrisen att kulminera. Förslagen syftade till att fram till år 2030 stoppa vräkningar av utsatta personer, göra det svårare att spekulera i fastigheter, att försvåra korttidsuthyrningar ytterligare, samt att hyreskontrakt förlängs automatiskt.

Indexet steg till 57,4 i september, jämfört med reviderade 56,0 månaden före. Kompositindex för september, där även tillverkningsindustrin räknas in, steg till 57,6 jämfört med reviderade 56,1 i augusti. Det sammanvägda inköpschefsindexet för eurozonen låg kvar på samma nivå, 53,1, jämfört med föregående månad, enligt siffror från Bloomberg. articles.title: Publicistiska grunden för journalistik på TV4
articles.summary: Nyheter från TV4: Hur fungerar den publicistiska grunden för nyhets- och samhällsjournalistik på TV4?
articles.body_text: Hur fungerar den publicistiska grunden för nyhets- och samhällsjournalistik på TV4? 9 januari 2024 ・ Uppdaterad: 15 augusti 2025 TV4:s nyhets- och samhällsbevakning ska vara i ögonhöjd med tittarna. Vi vill vara nära, personliga och inkluderande. För alla i hela Sverige. Vi ska vara trovärdiga och relevanta. Vi testar nya visuella former och utvecklar det rörliga berättandet. Vi är både snabba, och fördjupande. Vi ger plats för både humor och allvar. Vi påverkar och berör. Vi avslöjar maktmissbruk, och värnar pressfrihet och yttrandefrihet. Vi producerar Nyhetsmorgon, Nyhetsdagen, Efter fem och kvällsnyheter. Vi nyhetsrapporterar på tv4.se och fördjupar i kortdokumentärerna Nyheterna Story. Vår mångfaldigt prisbelönta redaktion Kalla Fakta granskar makt och missförhållanden. TV4:s nyhets- och samhällsbevakning sker ur ett riksperspektiv, med hela Sverige och världen som bevakningsområde. Vi har 17 rikskorrar på sex orter i Sverige. De finns i Luleå, Umeå, Östersund, Skövde, Göteborg och Malmö. Vi bevakar världen via utrikesreportrar, korrar och stringers. Vår journalistik vilar på respekt för alla människors lika värde, oavsett politisk åskådning, religion eller sexuell läggning. Det innebär att vi låter många röster komma till tals, även de som bär åsikter som inte nödvändigtvis delas av medarbetarna på redaktionen eller TV4. Men det kan också innebära att vi tar bort artikelkommentarer som kränker, eller till exempel avstår gäster i direktsändning där vi bedömer att risken är stor för missbruk av öppenheten. TV4:s nyhets- och samhällsjournalistik är oberoende och obunden. Den står fri från politiska partier, organisationer, och näringsliv. Vi har ingen ledarsida eller politisk färg. Innehållet på våra plattformar bedöms och värderas av redaktörer, producenter och av ansvarig utgivare före publicering. Vi följer grundlagen och skyddar våra källor när de önskar anonymitet. Om vi refererar uppgifter från andra medier redovisar vi vilka medier eller andra informationskällor det handlar om. Annars berättar vi hur vi själva tagit reda på informationen, dock alltid med största respekt för källskydd.

articles.summary: För första gången finns alla partiledare på Tiktok, samtidigt som nästan hälften av alla förstagångsväljare säger att de oftare tar del av politik på sociala medier än i tidningar, radio och tv. articles.title: Paasikivi vid fronten
articles.summary: Joakim Paasikivi lämnar tryggheten i tv-studion för att själv uppleva krigets verklighet i Ukraina. I Charkiv - staden som dagligen bombas av ryska styrkor - ställs hans analys på prov när han möter kriget på nära håll. Där träffar han ukrainska drönarsoldater som spelar en avgörande roll i motståndet. Hur påverkas hans analys när han själv känner tryckvågen från explosionerna?

articles.title: Bortglömda fiskar
articles.summary: Teatrar och konserthus lockar allt oftare med olika sidoevenemang. Teater Västernorrland har musikquiz, Folkoperan sänder poddar från sin foajé och på Göteborgsoperan kan man höra föredrag eller vara med och dansa. De uppsluppna tillställningarna, före och efter konserter och föreställningar, lockar också en ny sorts publik. En av Östersjöfestivalens mest omtalade programpunkter, förutom musiken i Berwaldhallen, har varit “Bortglömda fiskar” - en oväntad kulinarisk träff med Kålrotsakademin och provsmakning av “svensk sushi”. “Gensvaret från publiken är enormt. Man vill bli överraskad”, konstaterar Emma Nyberg, exekutiv producent på Berwaldhallen. Och på frågan om vad nors och näbbgädda har att göra i ett konserthus kommer det självklara svaret snabbt: “Att äta gott och att lyssna på klassisk musik hör ihop, båda skärper och öppnar våra sinnen.”

articles.title: Pentagon stops using Anthropic tools after blacklisting company, BBC told
articles.summary: It labelled Anthropic a "supply chain risk" in February after the firm refused to remove safety guardrails from its tools.
articles.body_text: The US Department of Defence is no longer using Anthropic's AI tools, an official has told the BBC, months after it designated the company a supply chain risk on national security grounds. The Pentagon "has ceased the use of Anthropic products", the department official said in a statement on Monday. Secretary of Defence Pete Hegseth labelled Anthropic a supply chain risk in February, and announced that the Pentagon would stop using it by late August. It is not clear why there has been a delay. Multiple people familiar with the matter told the BBC that as recently as last week Anthopic's Claude model was still being used by the department in research, analysis and intelligence gathering as well as in military operations against Iran. It was viewed as a critical tool for sorting through vast quantities of information, the people said. They include former US defence officials and contractors who have worked closely with the Pentagon specifically on AI. A spokesman for Anthropic declined to comment when asked about the Pentagon's statement. The details of the department stopping all use of Anthropic's tools have not been previously reported. The firm had been used by the US government and military since 2024 and was the first advanced AI company to have its tools deployed in government agencies doing classified work. But earlier this year, the Pentagon pressed it to remove its safety guardrails from Claude and give the military unfettered access to its AI products. When Anthropic refused, citing concerns of mass surveillance and autonomous weapons, Hegseth designated the company a "national security supply-chain risk" - a law typically reserved for companies based in countries that pose a threat to the US. Anthropic said the move was "unprecedented and unlawful" and has sued the Trump administration in an effort to overturn the designation. As this legal fight has played out in the courts, the Pentagon has signed contracts with other major tech companies, including Google, xAI and OpenAI.

articles.title: Zelensky condemns 'horrific' Russian strike on boat carrying corn in Black Sea
articles.summary: The vessel's captain was killed and 11 crew members were rescued after the attack on the Turkish-owned ship, Ukraine's leader says.
articles.body_text: Ukraine's President Volodymyr Zelensky has condemned a "horrific" Russian attack on a vessel carrying corn in the Black Sea. The ship's captain was killed in the strike involving two drones, Zelensky said, and another sailor was unaccounted for. Eleven crew members - nationals of Azerbaijan and India - have been rescued. Romania said it had mounted a rescue mission after "a fire on the ship Royad Mammadov" outside the country's territorial waters. It said two people had died. Russia has not commented, but its defence ministry earlier said it had struck two cargo vessels. Russia has been pounding Ukrainian infrastructure in what it says is retaliation for Ukrainian attacks on Russian oil refineries and ships in the Black Sea. Monday's attack by Russia targeted "a civilian vessel in neutral waters carrying corn and owned by Turkey", Volodymyr Zelensky said. He did not give the location of the ship, but Romania's interior ministry said it had sunk about 30 nautical miles south of its port of Sfantu Gheorghe. "At around 11:00 (09:00 GMT), Coast Guard border police officers were informed that a fire had broken out on board a commercial vessel located within Romania's exclusive economic zone," the ministry said in a statement. "Eleven crew members have been rescued. Two deceased persons have also been identified," it added. Ukraine's president said he had "repeatedly proposed concrete steps to de-escalate the situation and ensure security in the Black Sea" - and other countries had made "relevant proposals" too. "But Russia consistently chooses terror and sinking civilian vessels instead of normal maritime navigation," Zelensky said. "Pressure is needed to restore global food security," he added. "And everyone who is genuinely interested in this must help." On Sunday, Russia's defence ministry said it would intensify its strikes across Ukraine in response to comments made by Zelensky earlier last week, in which he said Kyiv would ramp up its attacks on Russian oil refineries.

articles.title: Yemeni military says it has retaken Mokha and 'secured' Red Sea waterway
articles.summary: Saudi-backed forces say they seized the port city of Mocha, near the Bab al-Mandab Strait, at the start of an offensive against the Houthis.
articles.body_text: Yemeni pro-government forces backed by Saudi Arabia say they have retaken control of the Red Sea port city of Mokha and "secured" the Bab al-Mandab Strait at the start of a major offensive against the Iran-backed Houthi movement. The Yemeni military said National Shield, Giants Brigades and Tihama Resistance forces had captured Mokha on Monday afternoon with the help of Saudi air strikes. Hours earlier, the military said its forces had seized Dhubab airport, 45km (27 miles) to the south, and were besieging Houthi fighters inside the nearby town. There was no immediate comment from the Houthis, but Houthi-run media denied that government forces had made advances in Dhubab. The government said operations had also begun on other fronts on Monday, including the capital Sanaa, which fell to the Houthis at the start of the civil war 12 years ago. Meanwhile, a Saudi-led military coalition said its fighter jets were providing "round-the-clock" air support to the pro-government forces and had destroyed 324 "high-value" targets since the start of the offensive. Saudi air strikes killed a schoolgirl and a woman in the Sanhan and Saawan districts of Sanaa on Monday, according to Houth-run Al Masirah TV. Houthi spokesman Mohammed Abdul Salam said Saudi Arabia was committing "dozens of massacres" and that it must "bear all the consequences". The Houthi-run Humanitarian Operations Co-ordination Centre warned civilian airlines that Saudi airspace, except for the skies above the Islamic holy cities of Mecca and Medina, was no longer safe because it had become "a theatre of operations". On Sunday, the head of Yemen's internationally recognised Presidential Leadership Council announced the beginning of an offensive, dubbed Operation Yemen Dawn, aimed at retaking all territory held by the Houthis. Rashad al-Alimi insisted that all opportunities for de-escalation had been exhausted and called on all forces to carry out their assigned missions "until the country is liberated from the grip of the Houthi terrorist militia". It came after the Houthis reportedly cut a mountain road near the south-western city of Taiz, effectively leaving government forces and residents there surrounded.

articles.title: Nigeria NYSC abductions: Bombs preventing rescue of kidnapped youths, Imo police say
articles.summary: The father of one of the 19 young abductees tells the BBC he hasn't eaten in three days out of worry.
articles.body_text: Nigerian police say they have located a camp where 19 national youth service recruits are being held by gunmen but cannot move in as they believe the place is mined with explosives. Police Commissioner Audu Bosso said drones helped locate the camp where the prospective National Youth Service Corps (NYSC) members were taken after being abducted last week in the south-eastern Imo state. The exact location of the camp has not been disclosed and police have not identified those responsible for the kidnapping. Omotosho Adewale, whose child is among those abducted, told the BBC that the kidnappers had demanded a ransom of 50m naira ($37,680; £28,440), which he could not afford. "There's no peace of mind. I've not eaten in three days," he said in between tears. Adewale appealed to the government for help. Those kidnapped had been travelling from Ibadan in the south-west to NYSC orientation camps in Abia and Akwa Ibom states on Thursday when gunmen attacked their buses near Umunoha in Imo state. The NYSC is a compulsory one-year programme for most Nigerian university and polytechnic graduates. Participants, known as corps members, are posted to different parts of the country to work and take part in community service, as well as to foster a sense of national unity. Speaking to journalists, Bosso said they had tracked the kidnappers. "The drone actually showed us exactly their location. But our predicament is that with the intel we have... the camp is mined with IEDs [homemade bombs]," he said. Bulldozers and armoured vehicles are being deployed as police prepare for a rescue operation. Kidnapping for ransom is a major security problem in Nigeria, involving both criminal gangs and armed groups.

articles.title: Teenager's hand blown off during confrontation between France school protesters and riot police
articles.summary: The prefect of Pas-de-Calais says the 15-year-old's life is "not in danger" after the "very serious" incident.
articles.body_text: A 15-year-old boy's hand was blown off during a confrontation between police and demonstrators near a school in France, an official has said, as student protests continue across the country. The "very serious incident" happened in the northern city of Lens on Monday morning, according to the prefect of Pas-de-Calais, François-Xavier Lauch. "The student's life is not in danger," he said, adding that the teenager was transferred "very quickly" to a hospital nearby. Around 500 schools were partially or totally closed across the country on Monday amid student protests over the condition of school buildings and staffing which have led to clashes with police in recent days. There are mixed reports in French media about how the boy came to sustain the injury. The AFP news agency, citing a police union source, reported that the student appeared to have picked up a sting-ball grenade fired by riot police, which exploded in his hand. However, regional newspaper La Voix Du Nord quoted a girl, who was reportedly standing near the teenager, as saying he did not pick up the grenade. "He didn't pick it up. I was there, I saw it. He didn't pick it up, he didn't catch it," she was quoted as saying. When asked about the incident, Lens Mayor Sylvain Robert said the circumstances still needed to be clarified. "Like you, and like many others, I have seen some videos showing the aftermath. But I did not see how the operation was organised, either by the police or by the students," he told French media. A regional prosecutor said an investigation would be carried out by the French police watchdog, the General Inspection of the National Police (IGPN), "so all light can be shed on what happened". The incident took place close to the Auguste Béhal high school, the prefect said.

articles.title: Georgia officials hunt for suspect in shooting that killed two and injured 35
articles.summary: A homecoming celebration turned into a scene of deadly violence, as dozens of shots were fired into a crowd.
articles.body_text: Investigators in the US state of Georgia are on the hunt for a suspect in a mass shooting that erupted in the early hours of Sunday, killing two people and injuring 35 more. A crowd of roughly 1,000 people had gathered for a block party in the southern rural community of Vienna when, according to officials, more than 50 shots were fired. Two of the victims were pronounced dead at the scene, while another 25 were transported to multiple nearby hospitals, some in critical condition. No known arrests have been made and authorities have not given a possible motive for the violence. Victims ranged in age from 14 to 51. The incident occurred on Sunday morning around 01:30 local time (05:30 GMT), during a Dooly High School homecoming celebration, though it was not a school-sponsored event. "Our hearts are with the families grieving the loss of loved ones, those who were injured, and everyone affected by this tragedy," the school said in a statement. Anticipating a large gathering, authorities from the Dooly County Sheriff's Office were already positioned at both ends of the crowd as gunfire rang out. "Some people were reporting fireworks and then someone said somebody been shot," Dooly County Sheriff Craig Peavy told local media. Peavy said officials then worked their way through the crowd, as people ran scrambling in different directions, while authorities made their way towards victims. Ashley Gee, who was there, told the Atlanta Journal-Constitution news outlet that the barrage of gunfire sounded "like a machine gun". Authorities arrived and found several people injured. The two deceased victims were found several blocks away from the scene of the shooting on Pine Street. Dooly County Coroner Brett Walls told the BBC's US media partner, CBS News, the two killed were both men, ages 20 and 23.

articles.title: No 10 says RAF Fairford is 'safe' after US withdraws bombers
articles.summary: US media reported a new threat led to the bombers being removed on Sunday, following an incident near the base last week.
articles.body_text: Downing Street has insisted RAF Fairford is safe, after the US withdrew all of its bombers from the military base. The Pentagon confirmed on Sunday it had removed its bombers - thought to be about a dozen B-1s - from the base back to their home stations in America. US media reported a new threat led to the bombers being removed, which follows a major incident on 27 September when police were alerted to three "suspicious vehicles" near the airbase. A No 10 spokesperson said he would not comment on "foreign nations' military operations", but said the base was safe, and pointed to US President Donald Trump's comments last week, where he "praised our police, defence and security services" in relation to the base. He added that Defence Secretary Wes Streeting had said last week, "we have tried and tested approaches to defend our bases around the country and throughout the world". Speaking on Monday, US Secretary of State Marco Rubio said he would not directly tie last week's incident to the decision to pull bombers from RAF Fairford. He added: "It's not unusual to see movement of assets to different parts of the world based on exercises, redeployments, people changing out and new people coming in, new planes coming in and old planes going out." Rubio said the US still has full confidence in the security of all its bases and that British authorities have been very cooperative since the incident. US Vice President JD Vance later said the bombers were moved out of an "abundance of caution", adding Washington feels Iran is doing what it has "done for 49 years... which is engage in acts of terrorism against the US and against a lot of other people". RAF Fairford - in the Cotswolds in Gloucestershire - is at the centre of an incident being investigated by counter-terror police. Five men were initially arrested on suspicion of terror offences and subsequently released on bail. A sixth man, a UK-Iranian national, was also later arrested and released on bail. Whitehall sources have not disputed that the decision from Washington to remove the bombers was in response to the incident at the airbase in Gloucestershire.

articles.title: Flydubai co-pilot planned to crash plane into airport, reports suggest
articles.summary: The Omani national was a "lone wolf" extremist, according to the reports.
articles.body_text: The co-pilot accused of trying to hijack a flydubai plane planned to crash the aircraft into Tel Aviv's Ben Gurion airport or a tower block in the Israeli city, US and Israeli reports suggest. The Omani national was a "lone wolf" extremist, according to the reports. The United Arab Emirates' attorney-general has said the co-pilot attempted to carry out a "terrorist act" on flight FZ1073 from Dubai to Tel Aviv last Wednesday. He attacked and wounded the captain with the emergency crash axe kept in the cockpit before being overpowered by passengers. Another crew travelling on the plane was able to land it in Saudi Arabia. Israel's prime minister has said the co-pilot underwent "Islamist radical indoctrination" and the captain, passengers and a second crew prevented "a 9/11 disaster". More details about the co-pilot of the flydubai flight – whom multiple reports have named as Hamam al-Hammami – emerged over the weekend as he continued to be questioned in the UAE, with Israeli representatives being updated. Israeli media cited sources with knowledge of the probe as saying the co-pilot told investigators that, having attacked Capt Smit Machchhar, he intended to continue flying the plane as normal into Israeli airspace and receive landing clearances from Ben Gurion airport. He then planned to crash the Boeing 737 MAX – with more than 180 passengers on board – into the airport or into a tower block in central Tel Aviv, in the style of al-Qaeda's 11 September 2001 attacks in the US, according to the reports. The sources are quoted as saying he was most likely to have acted alone rather than on behalf of a radical organisation or foreign government. The co-pilot also reportedly told investigators that he had intended to hijack and crash a previous flight to Tel Aviv but changed his mind because he knew someone on board. There was no immediate comment from Emirati or Israeli authorities. UAE Attorney-General Hamad al-Shamsi said on Saturday that his country's investigations would establish the full circumstances, motives and any links related to the incident, and that the results would be announced upon their conclusion.

articles.title: Anuv Jain: Rising Indian singer on new music and future hopes
articles.summary: The star reveals why he is "very selective" about releasing music - and shares his future collab hopes.
articles.body_text: Can you find success as an Indian artist, outside of the Bollywood machine, while making music that feels like you? Well according to Anuv Jain it's possible - and you can even create something "beautiful". The singer-songwriter's soft vocals have gained hundreds of millions of views on YouTube - not an easy feat as an independent artist in India's music scene. BBC Newsbeat met Jain as he prepared for the final shows on the European leg of his first world tour to find out why he's taking his time and "hoping for the best". "It's not about the numbers," Jain tells us backstage, ahead of his sold-out performance at London's Roundhouse. Jain is from Ludhiana in the Punjab region of India and began singing as a teenager. His tracks have since racked up hundreds of millions of views on YouTube with their emotional storylines about relationships and heartbreak. Jain primarily sings in Hindi, with his pieces often exploring deep emotions like love and longing. Fans talk about feeling like his music soundtracks their lives and is personal to them. His accessible style has attracted 3.9 million followers on Instagram and more than 20 million monthly listeners on Spotify. According to Jain, the secret to his success is simple. When writing music, he says, he imagines how someone listening in the car, going for a run or sitting alone at night would feel hearing the song.

articles.title: Nobel Prize for Medicine for showing inner workings of the brain
articles.summary: US psychiatrist and neurologist Karl Deisseroth and his German colleagues Peter Hegemann and Georg Nagel have been awarded for their work.
articles.body_text: US psychiatrist and neurologist Karl Deisseroth and his German colleagues Peter Hegemann and Georg Nagel have been awarded this year's Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine for their work in the field of optogenetics. Their research has helped scientists learn more about the inner workings of the brain, to better understand how the human mind works. The Nobel Committee praised the trio for laying the foundation of a new era in neuroscience by revealing how to switch on and off neural circuits behind "specific memories, feelings, and behaviours relevant for neurological and psychiatric disorders". In clinical medicine, researchers are using the method to try to restore sight in people with visual impairment . "Optogenetics has fundamentally altered our understanding of the brain," the Nobel Assembly said. "Every day brings new discoveries, helping to solve one of humanity's great mysteries: how our incredible brain works." The winners said it was "absolutely wonderful" to get the award, and that it was an honour to share the accolade with friends. The three men will also share the £900,000 (12 million Swedish kronor) prize money. Per Svenningsson, chair of the Nobel Committee for Physiology or Medicine, explained: "Optogenetics provides opportunities for mapping the brain in a way that we could once only dream of." Before, the inner workings behind feelings, behaviours and bodily functions were more of a mystery to scientists. Optogentics is a way to illuminate brain pathways, using a special protein borrowed from algae that scientists use to control cell electrical activity using light. In the early 2000s, Hegemann and Nagel discovered channelrhodopsin, the algal protein with unique properties.

articles.title: Spain's Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez calls early election
articles.summary: Sánchez says Spain will head to the polls on 29 November after recent defeats on measures aimed at addressing the country's housing crisis.
articles.body_text: Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez has called an early election for 29 November after recent defeats on legislation aimed at addressing the country's housing crisis. Speculation about a snap election had been building over the weekend after parliament rejected two decree laws put forward by the minority government to protect tenants in the rental market. The eviction of an 87-year-old woman from her home after she was unable to afford a sharp rent rise has sparked nationwide protests and increased pressure for housing reform. In a televised address on Monday, Sánchez said that to push reforms through he needed "a broader progressive majority" that can "overcome the resistance of the elites". Housing has not been the only issue causing problems for Sánchez's leadership in recent months, with his party having been caught up in numerous corruption scandals and facing pressure on other cost-of-living issues and immigration. "We have made mistakes and have not achieved everything we had set out to do," Sánchez said, acknowledging there were still "a lot of problems to solve, particularly in the areas of inequality, of public services and access to housing". Sánchez's left-wing coalition government is made up of his ruling Socialist party and junior partner the Sumar alliance, and does not have a majority in parliament. Spain was not due to hold a general election until the summer of 2027 at the latest. Sánchez has been prime minister since June 2018. His Socialist party finished second in the last election, in 2023. Although the conservative People's Party won the most seats, it fell short of a majority. Sánchez remained in power after striking agreements with left-wing parties and securing support from Catalan and Basque nationalist and pro-independence groups. Most opinion polls suggest the conservatives are likely to emerge as the largest party in the next election. However, they would be expected to need the support of the hard-right Vox party to form a government.

articles.title: 'Not again': Arrest of US marine for murder reignites protests in Japan's Okinawa
articles.summary: For many locals on this island, the arrest has brought decades of frustration back to the fore.
articles.body_text: For many Okinawa locals, the arrest of a US soldier accused of robbing and killing a woman in a hotel room has reignited decades of frustration over crimes involving US military personnel there. "Honestly my first reaction was, 'Not again,'" 52-year-old longtime Okinawa resident Ai Sato told the BBC. "Nothing has changed since I was a child. How many times are we going to repeat the same thing, create more victims, cause their families to suffer, and ultimately, cause the people of Okinawa to grieve?" Akemi Oshiro, a 62-year-old Ginowan resident shared similar sentiments. "I know we shouldn't get used to terrible things like this, but because they keep happening, I've stopped being surprised," she told the BBC. Okinawa hosts the largest US military presence in Japan. It is home to several US military bases and tens of thousands of American troops. US Marine Lance Corporal Devin Jacob Ballard, 20, was arrested by Japanese police on Sunday. Police say an investigation is underway and that Ballard is in Japanese custody because the alleged crime was unrelated to official military duties. Whether a US service member is acting in the performance of official duty or not can determine which country has primary jurisdiction. When Japan has jurisdiction, but the suspect is under US custody, they can retain custody until Japan brings charges. Ballard was assigned to III Marine Expeditionary Force and stationed at Marine Corps Air Station Futenma in Ginowan City. The Okinawa prefectural police say 39-year-old Anna Yagi was found dead early 3 October in a hotel room in Naha. Security footage allegedly shows a man believed to be the suspect entering the hotel with the woman and leaving alone with her belongings. Local media citing police have reported that Yagi appeared to have been strangled with a cord. Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi registered an official protest with Washington. But residents like Sato feel that's far from enough.

articles.title: Trade: How India became dangerously addicted to Chinese imports
articles.summary: India’s toy shops provide an unlikely barometer by which to measure its economic relationship with China.
articles.body_text: Take a walk into an Indian toy shop and as well as picking up a new favourite plaything for a child, you might just get an insight into how the nation is battling for a better economic relationship with its all-powerful neighbour China. Six years ago, in an attempt to push local manufacturing and keep substandard toys out of its market, India raised tariffs on imported toys from 20% to 60% and eventually to 70%. Retailers were up in arms and said that domestic firms could never match the foreign-made stuff. But the combination of higher customs duties and quality control standards worked. Indian imports of toys fell by a third from nearly $300m (£227m) in 2020 to $100m this year, while exports rose from around $129m to $200m in the same period. Moreover, the country was able to drastically reduce its dependence on China, which held a 70% share of the local toy market. The sector stands out as a rare exception in India's otherwise unsuccessful attempts to rebalance an increasingly lopsided trading relationship with its larger neighbour, which some experts say, is now among the most asymmetric in the world. Even as diplomatic ties between the two countries completely broke down following the Galwan Valley clashes in 2020 and Delhi announced a slew of anti-dumping duties and a ban on Chinese apps such as Tik Tok, its trade deficit with Beijing has only ballooned - from $44bn in 2020 to an eye-popping $112bn this year. "India's economic dependence on China continued to deepen while political, security, and investment ties were at their lowest point," Kevin Zongzhe Li, a Washington-based Fellow at the Asia Society Policy Institute's Centre for China Analysis, told the BBC. More worryingly, exports to China remained below pre-pandemic level even as imports doubled in this period. "China now supplies over 30% of India's industrial imports, and India depends on it for more than 100 critical products. And the imbalance is worsening," says Ajay Srivastava of the Delhi-based Global Trade and Research Initiative (GTRI). If the rapid pace of imports continues, bilateral deficit could jump to $134bn, giving Beijing even more leverage over Indian industry, according to Srivastava. On the sidelines of the Brics summit in Delhi in September, amid a deepening thaw between the Asian giants, Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Chinese President Xi Jinping vowed to address these "structural trade imbalances and supply chain issues". But given how deeply entrenched Chinese imports have become to India's industrial economy, this will be a formidable task for Delhi, experts told the BBC.

articles.title: Brazil election goes to run-off as right-wing Flávio Bolsonaro wins first round
articles.summary: With neither candidate getting more than 50% of the vote, the election will go to a run-off on 25 October.
articles.body_text: Right-wing Flávio Bolsonaro has won the first round of Brazil's presidential election, beating left-wing President Lula da Silva, but falling short of an outright majority. There will be a run-off between the two candidates on 25 October. Bolsonaro is the son of the former president Jair Bolsonaro, who is serving a 27-year prison sentence for masterminding a failed coup after losing the 2022 election. Sunday's vote was close, with President Lula polling slightly ahead during the campaign. With almost all of the votes counted, Bolsonaro has 47% to Lula's 45% of the vote. Bolsonaro's result exceeded expectations, meaning the second round now looks like his to lose, given some of the other candidates knocked out in the first round were right-wing alternatives. His Liberal Party (PL) also had the most governors, senators and federal deputies elected in the results so far, meaning the party is expected to have the most influence in Congress. The majority of Latin America has now elected right-wing presidents, aligned to the Trump administration, and the run-off will determine whether Brazil – Latin America's largest country and economy – will follow suit. After casting his ballot, Lula, 80, warned the choice was between democracy and "barbarism". Bolsonaro, 45, said he wanted to "free the Brazilian people". Lula and Bolsonaro are the two biggest names in Brazilian politics, on the left and right, and this campaign has polarised Brazil yet again: with themes of sovereignty, crime, the economy and corruption being top concerns for voters. Lula is more popular in Brazil's poorer northeast, among low-income voters, Catholics, and women. He is seeking a fourth term in office, after being elected in 2002, 2006 and then a later non-consecutive term in 2022. In that election, he beat Jair Bolsonaro by less than 2% of the vote, the closest presidential election result in Brazil's history.

articles.body_text: La selección peruana ya tiene todo listo para su último compromiso de la fecha FIFA de octubre. Perú vs. Colombia se medirán este martes 6 de octubre en Miami, en un encuentro que marcará el cierre de la gira norteamericana dirigida por Mano Menezes. El partido comenzará a las 6:45 p. m. articles.body_text: Un incendio se reporta en el parque Domodossola, en Malecón de la Reserva, distrito de Miraflores. El siniestro ocurrió al promediar las 9 de la mañana. Al lugar llegaron 16 unidades del Cuerpo de los Bomberos del Perú para atender la emergencia que causa preocupación entre los asistentes a dicha zona. Mario Casaretto, gerente de Gestión del Riesgo de Desastres de la Municipalidad Metropolitana de Lima (MML), indicó que parte de las geomallas utilizadas para evitar desprendimiento de rocas y plantas, han sido afectadas. Las llamas están cerca al centro comercial Larcomar y exactamente a 70 metros el recientemente inaugurado teleférico de Miraflores. Según testigos del siniestro, un grupo de turistas que paseaba por la zona fueron llevados nuevamente a su hotel para no ser afectados por el humo. Personal de Serenazgo y la Policía Nacional del Perú (PNP), han cerrado esta vía en ambas direcciones. En tanto, los bomberos continúan realizando trabajos denodados para controlar el incendio y llegar hasta la zona donde se habría iniciado el fuego, sin embargo, el acceso al acantilado dificulta el acceso a las mangueras. Minutos más tarde de haberse producido el incendio, se reportó una persona herida. Canal N indicó que esta recibió atención en el lugar por parte de efectivos de la Policía Nacional del Perú (PNP), y personas que se encontraban en la zona. De acuerdo con información preliminar, se trataría aparentemente de una persona en situación de calle.

articles.body_text: El candidato a primer regidor de la Municipalidad de Lima por Renovación Popular, Rafael López Aliaga, defendió su postulación y la posibilidad que pueda asumir como nuevo burgomaestre en el próximo periodo. El dirigente político sostuvo que su inscripción respetó las normas vigentes en la legislación electoral y que, tal como está la norma, podría incluso volver a postular en el 2030. “De acuerdo a la ley, en este minuto, hoy día yo podría ir hasta un tercer periodo. No es mi intención, pero podría”, declaró el postulante en una entrevista con RPP este viernes. El aspirante edil explicó que dicha opción legal derivó de su postulación como teniente alcalde y no como alcalde titular. López Aliaga precisó que la prohibición de reelección inmediata se refiere de forma exclusiva al cargo de alcalde. El candidato recordó que el Jurado Nacional de Elecciones respaldó la validez de su lista partidaria de manera definitiva en fallos recientes. “El verbo que se debe aplicar acá es postular, no estoy postulando a alcalde, estoy postulando a teniente alcalde, y por ausencia del titular me toca asumir”, afirmó el aspirante. El dirigente reiteró que su candidatura cumplió con los requisitos legales establecidos para el proceso edil. López Aliaga señaló que la normativa vigente prevé la entrega de la credencial de alcalde al primer regidor en caso de victoria de su partido. El postulante indicó que asumirá la conducción de Lima si Renovación Popular logra el triunfo en las elecciones del 4 de octubre. “Mi opinión personal, te digo que un alcalde sí debería tener una reelección, una reelección inmediata para poder terminar. Cuatro años es muy poco”, expresó el líder político. El candidato argumentó que las gestiones municipales requieren mayor tiempo para la ejecución de obras de infraestructura en la capital. “Este miércoles voy a declarar como acusador a toda la mafia criminal de ONPE y voy a meterlos a la cárcel 20 años por haber robado la voluntad popular”, sostuvo el dirigente. El candidato denunció supuestas irregularidades cometidas por las autoridades electorales durante los comicios anteriores del 2026 cuando buscó ser presidente de la República. López Aliaga, en otro momento, cuestionó la imparcialidad del Jurado Nacional de Elecciones en la resolución de las tachas presentadas contra postulantes. Por esto, confirmó la presencia de personeros en todas las mesas de votación para la vigilancia del escrutinio en la capital.

articles.title: El dólar abre a la baja en S/3,41 pese al avance global de la divisa
articles.summary: El precio del dólar abrió este lunes 5 de octubre en S/3,416, por debajo de los S/3,436 del cierre anterior, lo que representó una apreciación inicial del sol de 0,54%.
articles.body_text: El precio del dólar abrió este lunes 5 de octubre en S/3,416, por debajo de los S/3,436 del cierre anterior, lo que representó una apreciación inicial del sol de 0,54%. El movimiento se produjo pese al avance del dólar a nivel internacional, con el Índice del Dólar Estadounidense (DXY) subiendo 0,34%, mientras los mercados continúan ajustando sus expectativas sobre la trayectoria de tasas de la Reserva Federal (Fed). “Luego del último reporte de empleo de Estados Unidos, el mercado ha reducido significativamente la probabilidad de una subida de tasas de la Fed en octubre. Sin embargo, los rendimientos de largo plazo permanecen elevados, con el Treasury a 10 años alrededor de 5,29% y el de 30 años cerca de 5,65%”, explicó Jorge Luis Huayta, trader FX de Kambista. Esta semana, la atención también estará puesta en la publicación de las minutas del FOMC, prevista para el miércoles. En paralelo, el petróleo continúa entre los factores relevantes para las expectativas de inflación, con el Brent por encima de US$100 por barril, mientras el mercado sigue la evolución de las negociaciones vinculadas al conflicto en Medio Oriente y la oferta global de crudo. Entre los metales, la plata avanzó 1,32% y el cobre 0,18%, mientras el oro se mantuvo prácticamente estable, con una variación de -0,01%. En el mercado local, el USD/PEN abrió en S/3,416 y posteriormente avanzó hasta S/3,418 en las primeras negociaciones. En la región, el comportamiento de las monedas fue mixto, con avances del real brasileño de 4,81%, del peso chileno de 1,79% y del peso mexicano de 0,29%. La jornada local también se desarrolla después de las elecciones regionales y municipales del domingo, cuyos resultados podrían ser relevantes para la percepción de gobernabilidad, inversión regional y ejecución de proyectos. “Esta semana también será relevante la decisión de política monetaria del BCRP, prevista para el jueves, por su impacto en el diferencial de tasas del sol frente al dólar y otras monedas de la región”, agregó Huayta. En el ámbito local, el mercado también mantiene entre sus factores de seguimiento al Fenómeno El Niño Costero, luego de que el ENFEN mantuviera el estado de alerta y señalara la posibilidad de que el evento continúe hasta mediados del otoño de 2027.

articles.body_text: Un incendio se reporta en el parque Domodossola, en Malecón de la Reserva, distrito de Miraflores. El siniestro ocurrió al promediar las 9 de la mañana. Al lugar llegaron 16 unidades del Cuerpo de los Bomberos del Perú para atender la emergencia que causa preocupación entre los asistentes a dicha zona. Mario Casaretto, gerente de Gestión del Riesgo de Desastres de la Municipalidad Metropolitana de Lima (MML), indicó que parte de las geomallas utilizadas para evitar desprendimiento de rocas y plantas, han sido afectadas. Las llamas están cerca al centro comercial Larcomar y exactamente a 70 metros el recientemente inaugurado teleférico de Miraflores. Según testigos del siniestro, un grupo de turistas que paseaba por la zona fueron llevados nuevamente a su hotel para no ser afectados por el humo. Personal de Serenazgo y la Policía Nacional del Perú (PNP), han cerrado esta vía en ambas direcciones. En tanto, los bomberos continúan realizando trabajos denodados para controlar el incendio y llegar hasta la zona donde se habría iniciado el fuego, sin embargo, el acceso al acantilado dificulta el acceso a las mangueras. Minutos más tarde de haberse producido el incendio, se reportó una persona herida. Canal N indicó que esta recibió atención en el lugar por parte de efectivos de la Policía Nacional del Perú (PNP), y personas que se encontraban en la zona. De acuerdo con información preliminar, se trataría aparentemente de una persona en situación de calle.

articles.body_text: El candidato a primer regidor de la Municipalidad de Lima por Renovación Popular, Rafael López Aliaga, defendió su postulación y la posibilidad que pueda asumir como nuevo burgomaestre en el próximo periodo. El dirigente político sostuvo que su inscripción respetó las normas vigentes en la legislación electoral y que, tal como está la norma, podría incluso volver a postular en el 2030. “De acuerdo a la ley, en este minuto, hoy día yo podría ir hasta un tercer periodo. No es mi intención, pero podría”, declaró el postulante en una entrevista con RPP este viernes. El aspirante edil explicó que dicha opción legal derivó de su postulación como teniente alcalde y no como alcalde titular. López Aliaga precisó que la prohibición de reelección inmediata se refiere de forma exclusiva al cargo de alcalde. El candidato recordó que el Jurado Nacional de Elecciones respaldó la validez de su lista partidaria de manera definitiva en fallos recientes. “El verbo que se debe aplicar acá es postular, no estoy postulando a alcalde, estoy postulando a teniente alcalde, y por ausencia del titular me toca asumir”, afirmó el aspirante. El dirigente reiteró que su candidatura cumplió con los requisitos legales establecidos para el proceso edil. López Aliaga señaló que la normativa vigente prevé la entrega de la credencial de alcalde al primer regidor en caso de victoria de su partido. El postulante indicó que asumirá la conducción de Lima si Renovación Popular logra el triunfo en las elecciones del 4 de octubre. “Mi opinión personal, te digo que un alcalde sí debería tener una reelección, una reelección inmediata para poder terminar. Cuatro años es muy poco”, expresó el líder político. El candidato argumentó que las gestiones municipales requieren mayor tiempo para la ejecución de obras de infraestructura en la capital. “Este miércoles voy a declarar como acusador a toda la mafia criminal de ONPE y voy a meterlos a la cárcel 20 años por haber robado la voluntad popular”, sostuvo el dirigente. El candidato denunció supuestas irregularidades cometidas por las autoridades electorales durante los comicios anteriores del 2026 cuando buscó ser presidente de la República. López Aliaga, en otro momento, cuestionó la imparcialidad del Jurado Nacional de Elecciones en la resolución de las tachas presentadas contra postulantes. Por esto, confirmó la presencia de personeros en todas las mesas de votación para la vigilancia del escrutinio en la capital.

articles.title: Flávio Bolsonaro parte con ventaja ante Lula: las 3 claves que definirán la segunda vuelta en Brasil
articles.summary: Flávio Bolsonaro tiene una estrecha ventaja, pero necesita consolidar el voto de la derecha y captar apoyos de los candidatos que quedaron fuera. En cambio, Lula deberá apostar por movilizar a los abstencionistas y recuperar terreno, en una elección que los analistas consideran abierta y difícil de predecir
articles.body_text: Flávio Bolsonaro llega a la segunda vuelta de las elecciones en Brasil con una estrecha ventaja sobre Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, pero el resultado del 25 de octubre aún está abierto. Los dos candidatos entran ahora en una nueva batalla por los apoyos de los sectores que quedaron fuera de la primera vuelta y por movilizar a los electores que no acudieron a las urnas, en un escenario donde cada voto puede resultar decisivo. Con el 100% de mesas escrutadas, el senador Flávio Bolsonaro, hijo del exmandatario Jair Bolsonaro, obtuvo el 47,03 % de los votos, casi dos puntos más que el presidente Lula (45,16 %). Bolsonaro no solo superó a Lula en porcentaje, sino que sus 56,1 millones de votos están por encima de los 49 millones que obtuvo su padre en las elecciones del 2018 y los 51 millones del 2022. Para imponerse en segunda vuelta, la principal fuente de nuevos votos para Bolsonaro son los candidatos menores de derecha, que concentraron cerca del 8% de las preferencias. Como todos tienen posiciones conservadoras, el candidato del Partido Liberal tiene margen para negociar su apoyo y consolidar el voto anti Lula o anti Partido de los Trabajadores (PT). Mientras que Lula tiene menos margen para sumar adherencias de candidatos derrotados. Entonces, su estrategia debería pasar por movilizar a los abstencionistas, el 21% del padrón, y captar votos blancos y nulos. Para Francesco Tucci, director de la Carrera de Comunicación y Periodismo en la Universidad Peruana de Ciencias Aplicadas (UPC), la ventaja de dos puntos de Flávio Bolsonaro es demasiado estrecha como para considerar que está definida la elección. El analista internacional sostiene que el resultado final dependerá principalmente de tres variables: la capacidad de los candidatos de movilizar a los abstencionistas, de captar los votos de quienes quedaron fuera de la contienda, y de evitar que parte del electorado opte por el voto blanco o nulo. Tucci considera especialmente relevante enfocarse en los más de 33 millones de electores que no acudieron a las urnas. “El candidato que sepa activar el voto abstencionista tendrá una ventaja importante”, indica. Precisa que no es posible asumir que quienes no votaron en la primera vuelta sean necesariamente electores contrarios a Lula o favorables a Bolsonaro. Más bien, manifiesta que una parte de ese electorado puede estar expresando su rechazo a la fuerte polarización política del país, sin identificarse plenamente con ninguna de las dos opciones. Sobre la transferencia de votos de los candidatos eliminados, Tucci remarca que estos no necesariamente pasarán automáticamente a Bolsonaro. Señala que hasta ahora solo uno de esos candidatos ha manifestado claramente su intención de movilizar a sus electores contra Lula: Romeu Zema, del Partido Novo. Otros han optado por mantener una posición neutral, por lo que Bolsonaro tendrá que negociar y convencer a esos sectores. Para el analista, también se debe considerar la fragmentación existente dentro de la propia derecha brasileña, entre sectores conservadores y de extrema derecha. Por ello, cree que la ventaja obtenida por Bolsonaro en la primera vuelta constituye un punto de partida favorable, pero no una garantía de transferencia automática de votos. El embajador Juan Álvarez Vita indica que Flávio Bolsonaro parte con una ventaja que, aunque estrecha, podría darle una posición favorable, por que en la actual coyuntura dos puntos es difícil de revertir. Coincide en que los electores de los otros candidatos no necesariamente tienen definido su apoyo automático para la segunda vuelta. Para Lula, una de las principales tareas será recuperar la participación en regiones donde históricamente el PT tiene una base electoral importante, especialmente en el noreste, precisa Tucci. El analista sostiene que existe margen para movilizar a electores que tradicionalmente apoyan al PT y que no acudieron a votar en la primera vuelta. Al mismo tiempo, el candidato izquierdista “tendrá que intentar atraer a sectores de centro y a votantes de partidos moderados que quedaron fuera de la segunda vuelta”. Tucci cree que una movilización intensa en el noreste, combinada con una captación significativa del voto moderado, podría modificar el escenario de cara al 25 de octubre. Con estas variables sobre la mesa, Tucci evita anticipar un ganador. “Mucho dependerá también de la fragmentación en el apoyo a Lula. Si la abstención continúa elevada y Bolsonaro no consigue una transferencia importante de los votos de los candidatos eliminados, su ventaja inicial podría reducirse. En sentido contrario, una movilización fuerte de Lula en el noreste y la incorporación de votantes de centro podrían modificar la relación de fuerzas. Es un voto extremadamente complejo y difícil de predecir”, resume Tucci. Álvarez Vita sostiene que el principal margen de crecimiento de Lula está en el 21% del electorado que no acudió a votar, además de quienes optaron por el voto blanco o nulo. Pero advierte que movilizar a ese sector será difícil. El embajador identifica además el aumento del costo de vida como uno de los principales puntos débiles de Lula de cara al balotaje. Según su lectura, el deterioro económico puede influir en aquellos electores que aún no tienen decidido su voto y convertirse en un factor que favorezca a la oposición. También intuye que precisamente en ese bolsón de abstencionistas podría haber un buen porcentaje de personas inconformes con la situación económica, pero que tampoco se sienten representadas por una opción como la de Flávio Bolsonaro. Tucci indica que la ausencia de Lula en los debates de la primera vuelta pudo responder a una estrategia para preservar su electorado ya consolidado. articles.body_text: El candidato a primer regidor de la Municipalidad de Lima por Renovación Popular, Rafael López Aliaga, defendió su postulación y la posibilidad que pueda asumir como nuevo burgomaestre en el próximo periodo. El dirigente político sostuvo que su inscripción respetó las normas vigentes en la legislación electoral y que, tal como está la norma, podría incluso volver a postular en el 2030. “De acuerdo a la ley, en este minuto, hoy día yo podría ir hasta un tercer periodo. No es mi intención, pero podría”, declaró el postulante en una entrevista con RPP este viernes. El aspirante edil explicó que dicha opción legal derivó de su postulación como teniente alcalde y no como alcalde titular. López Aliaga precisó que la prohibición de reelección inmediata se refiere de forma exclusiva al cargo de alcalde. El candidato recordó que el Jurado Nacional de Elecciones respaldó la validez de su lista partidaria de manera definitiva en fallos recientes. “El verbo que se debe aplicar acá es postular, no estoy postulando a alcalde, estoy postulando a teniente alcalde, y por ausencia del titular me toca asumir”, afirmó el aspirante. El dirigente reiteró que su candidatura cumplió con los requisitos legales establecidos para el proceso edil. López Aliaga señaló que la normativa vigente prevé la entrega de la credencial de alcalde al primer regidor en caso de victoria de su partido. El postulante indicó que asumirá la conducción de Lima si Renovación Popular logra el triunfo en las elecciones del 4 de octubre. “Mi opinión personal, te digo que un alcalde sí debería tener una reelección, una reelección inmediata para poder terminar. Cuatro años es muy poco”, expresó el líder político. El candidato argumentó que las gestiones municipales requieren mayor tiempo para la ejecución de obras de infraestructura en la capital. “Este miércoles voy a declarar como acusador a toda la mafia criminal de ONPE y voy a meterlos a la cárcel 20 años por haber robado la voluntad popular”, sostuvo el dirigente. El candidato denunció supuestas irregularidades cometidas por las autoridades electorales durante los comicios anteriores del 2026 cuando buscó ser presidente de la República. López Aliaga, en otro momento, cuestionó la imparcialidad del Jurado Nacional de Elecciones en la resolución de las tachas presentadas contra postulantes. Por esto, confirmó la presencia de personeros en todas las mesas de votación para la vigilancia del escrutinio en la capital.

articles.body_text: El Juzgado Penal de Investigación Preparatoria de Huaylas-Caraz dictó 18 meses de prisión preventiva contra dos investigados de nacionalidad venezolana por el asesinato de Susy Aponte Polo, conocida como China Polo. La resolución judicial incluye cargos por sicariato y lesiones graves contra cuatro ciudadanos que sufrieron disparos de arma de fuego durante el ataque. El Poder Judicial ordenó el internamiento penal de Luis Iván Obispo Díaz en calidad de autor directo del homicidio por encargo cometido en Huaylas. La Fiscalía le atribuye un pago de S/15,000 por ejecutar el disparo directo contra la postulante a la gobernación regional. La medida judicial comprendió además a Ronald José Toro Ardila como presunto financista y cómplice primario de la operación criminal. El Ministerio Público acreditó transferencias digitales desde su cuenta bancaria para pagar el hospedaje, los traslados y la compra del teléfono celular usado en el hecho. La Fiscalía sostuvo que ambos procesados carecen de arraigo domiciliario en el país y representan un peligro de fuga extremo. Las pericias balísticas, los testimonios presenciales y las inspecciones técnicas reforzaron los elementos de convicción aceptados por el juzgado. El juez dispuso el traslado de los imputados a un penal mientras continúan las diligencias de la investigación preparatoria. Las autoridades buscan determinar la identidad de los autores intelectuales que ordenaron el crimen de la candidata regional. El sicario atacó a disparos a China Polo el 19 de septiembre en las inmediaciones del mercado central de la ciudad de Caraz, en Áncash. La víctima realizaba una caminata proselitista junto a simpatizantes de su agrupación política cuando recibió el impacto directo en la cabeza. El atacante al usar su arma de fuego contra Aponte hirió a transeúntes y comensales en el lugar del suceso. Una mujer de 72 años perdió la vida doce días después debido a las graves heridas causadas por los proyectiles. Efectivos de la Policía Nacional capturaron a Obispo Díaz en la escena del crimen en posesión de una pistola tras un enfrentamiento armado. Las fuerzas del orden detuvieron posteriormente a Toro Ardila en Lima mediante un operativo de rastreo de sus cuentas bancarias.

articles.body_text: El candidato a primer regidor de la Municipalidad de Lima por Renovación Popular, Rafael López Aliaga, defendió su postulación y la posibilidad que pueda asumir como nuevo burgomaestre en el próximo periodo. El dirigente político sostuvo que su inscripción respetó las normas vigentes en la legislación electoral y que, tal como está la norma, podría incluso volver a postular en el 2030. “De acuerdo a la ley, en este minuto, hoy día yo podría ir hasta un tercer periodo. No es mi intención, pero podría”, declaró el postulante en una entrevista con RPP este viernes. El aspirante edil explicó que dicha opción legal derivó de su postulación como teniente alcalde y no como alcalde titular. López Aliaga precisó que la prohibición de reelección inmediata se refiere de forma exclusiva al cargo de alcalde. El candidato recordó que el Jurado Nacional de Elecciones respaldó la validez de su lista partidaria de manera definitiva en fallos recientes. “El verbo que se debe aplicar acá es postular, no estoy postulando a alcalde, estoy postulando a teniente alcalde, y por ausencia del titular me toca asumir”, afirmó el aspirante. El dirigente reiteró que su candidatura cumplió con los requisitos legales establecidos para el proceso edil. López Aliaga señaló que la normativa vigente prevé la entrega de la credencial de alcalde al primer regidor en caso de victoria de su partido. El postulante indicó que asumirá la conducción de Lima si Renovación Popular logra el triunfo en las elecciones del 4 de octubre. “Mi opinión personal, te digo que un alcalde sí debería tener una reelección, una reelección inmediata para poder terminar. Cuatro años es muy poco”, expresó el líder político. El candidato argumentó que las gestiones municipales requieren mayor tiempo para la ejecución de obras de infraestructura en la capital. “Este miércoles voy a declarar como acusador a toda la mafia criminal de ONPE y voy a meterlos a la cárcel 20 años por haber robado la voluntad popular”, sostuvo el dirigente. El candidato denunció supuestas irregularidades cometidas por las autoridades electorales durante los comicios anteriores del 2026 cuando buscó ser presidente de la República. López Aliaga, en otro momento, cuestionó la imparcialidad del Jurado Nacional de Elecciones en la resolución de las tachas presentadas contra postulantes. Por esto, confirmó la presencia de personeros en todas las mesas de votación para la vigilancia del escrutinio en la capital.

articles.title: At 19, founder raises $11M for Ghost, maker of a $3,499 computer for personal AI | TechCrunch
articles.summary: Ghost's first product is Core, a personal computer designed specifically for AI agents that can take actions on a person's behalf.
articles.body_text: For much of his life, Zain Javaid, 19, wanted to be a quant who uses math and data to guide his investment decisions. And for a while, he was one. But he got bored. Then, in 2022, ChatGPT was released, and he told TechCrunch, “I felt fundamentally excited in a way that I never had been before.” He became interested in personal AI, and that interest led him to start Ghost, which announced Monday that it has emerged from stealth after a year of building, along with an $11 million seed round led by Andreessen Horowitz. Other investors in the round include Abstract, Audacious Ventures, SV Angel, and Nova. His founding team includes Nicholas Chua, 19, Yifei Chen, 24, and Gautam Sharda, 23. Ghost’s first product is Core, a personal computer designed specifically for AI agents that can take actions on a person’s behalf. According to Javaid, the idea is to centralize a person’s data, from what’s on their desktop to apps to smart home devices, into one piece of hardware designed to continuously run AI agents that can act as an assistant, perform tasks, and understand a person’s life. “You can run models on existing hardware, but it’s a terrible experience on many levels,” said Javaid, who is also Core’s CEO. Core includes an Nvidia RTX Pro 4000 SFF Blackwell GPU (a type of chip commonly used to run AI models), said Javaid, adding that the GPU is bundled into the device’s price, so customers don’t need to buy one separately. He said it also has its own software layer, browser, and filing system and can continuously process information and tasks without constant prompting. Core costs $3,499. Preorders for the first batch open Monday, and shipping is scheduled for the last week of October. Javaid described Core as a “brain in a box” without a screen, which users access through a phone or app. Voice mode is also available, but users must speak into the Core app rather than the box itself. Core comes with three models preinstalled: Qwen-3.8-Next, Qwen-3.8-27B, and Gemma-4-31B. Javaid said users can also install other models from Hugging Face, where developers share AI models, or load their own trained models. Asked how Core differs from a Mac Mini, Apple’s small desktop computer that some people set up to run AI tools, Javaid said Core’s hardware and software were built specifically for running AI agents, with models already installed, while the Mac Mini is a general-purpose computer that can be configured for AI. “As new models or improvements to existing models come out, we can push out over-the-air updates, similar to how Tesla works,” Javaid said of Core, adding that if a new generation of models comes out, the company asks users whether they want to switch. “Users can also turn on auto-updates so they’re always running the latest generation of a given model.” The team currently builds the units at its San Francisco facility. Javaid said the goal is to sell a fully functioning computer that doesn’t require complex setup or configuration. He said the models and personal memory run locally, and that all personal information is encrypted so that no cloud provider or third party, including Ghost, can meaningfully access it. He also said users can control how much autonomy they give their Core agents, and that the device is programmed to keep working if Ghost shuts down. “All of the source code, logic, and model weights live on the device, not the services,” he said. “We build this device to not be dependent on having an outside entity maintaining the service.” He said the team is also building a firewall to limit how the agent can use its credentials, such as logins and passwords. The firewall “monitors every outgoing network request on the computer and if it sees the agent performing a sanctioned action or exfiltrating data it shouldn’t, it rejects the request and flags it for user review.” “The user owns all of it,” he said of the device, memory, and data. “Once you buy the hardware, everything is stored, run, and processed on the device.” He said he is not too worried about the competition, including from established tech companies. “People sometimes give incumbents credit for having already built the product because they have the ingredients,” he said. He credited Apple with good hardware and disruption, but said much of what Core is aiming to tackle is software: “The model reasons over your life, how it remembers, how it takes action, how it knows when to reach out,” he continued.

articles.title: Hot Girl Hotline is like 'Dear Abby' for the AI era | TechCrunch
articles.summary: Founded by two sisters, Hot Girl Hotline uses AI to give young women personalized dating and relationship advice, with an emphasis on safety and avoiding emotional dependency.
articles.body_text: Women throughout history have always sought out relationship advice, whether from newspaper columnists like “Dear Abby,” letters to Cosmo, or just chatting with girlfriends. In the social media era, you can instead post anonymously on Reddit relationship forums or look to social media creators who discuss the topic. Now, two sisters are launching a startup for young women, Hot Girl Hotline , which focuses on bringing AI into these conversations. I know what you may be thinking: With all the advances in AI technology, founders are building something for women to talk about their dating woes? Well … yes! The reality is that people have already been turning to large language models (LLMs) via apps like ChatGPT for this type of advice, and the team believes this type of activity should be handled more carefully. Unfortunately, as we’ve seen, chatting with a general-purpose chatbot about personal topics can sometimes lead to disastrous effects — especially for those who were already mentally fragile. ChatGPT, for example, has faced a wave of lawsuits over its alleged manipulative conversation tactics that plaintiffs say contributed to negative mental health effects, including, in some cases, suicide. The idea behind Hot Girl Hotline is to reach young women who are looking to have these sorts of private conversations while navigating dating life and relationships, but in a safer way. “We’re not trying to be an AI companion,” explained Baila Mudgil , formerly a social media consultant, who co-founded the startup with her sister Sumrin (“Sumi”), who studied computer science at Stanford. “A companion is really going after solving loneliness, escapism, boredom — and you can rely on a lot of emotional dependency from that AI companion.” Baila says the startup’s approach is to focus on offering quality advice grounded in behavioral science, but in a way that makes it feel like you’re chatting with a trusted friend or big sister. The conversation is often Socratic, with the AI asking you questions to help you arrive at the answer yourself. “This is not to replace speaking to a human. This is not clinical advice, and we have a lot of safeguards in place … we take safety really seriously,” Baila said. If conversations raise flags, for instance, the user is referred to resources such as the crisis hotline 988. “We believe the key to quality advice is not just knowing what to do next; it’s understanding why you’re doing it. So that’s a big piece of it,” added Sumi. Notably, the AI also knows when to end the conversation; it doesn’t keep asking follow-up questions to drag you further down a rabbit hole. Instead, it pushes users to go take action out in the real world rather than ruminate on the problem. The sisters believe there’s room for an app like this because not everyone wants to post on the web for advice, and there are times when you don’t want to bring up a personal, dating, or relationship-focused issue with a friend.

articles.title: HackerRank's AI interviewer offers a glimpse into what job interviews could become | TechCrunch
articles.summary: HackerRank’s AI interviewer has already conducted more than 500,000 interviews, with Snowflake, Snorkel, and Capgemini among its early testers.
articles.body_text: What happens when AI moves from helping job candidates to evaluating them? HackerRank , a platform used by companies to assess and hire developers, is offering a glimpse at what that future of job interviews could look like with Chakra , an AI agent that conducts interviews, observes candidates as they work, and evaluates not just their answers but also how they got there. After around six months in beta, HackerRank is making Chakra generally available to its customers on Monday. The startup says the AI interviewer has already conducted more than 500,000 interviews during testing, with companies including Snowflake, Snorkel, and Capgemini among those that tried it, while HackerRank also tested the product internally. AI has been a staple in job interviews for some time , with companies using voice agents and other automated tools to screen candidates and make the hiring process more efficient. Job seekers, meanwhile, have increasingly gained their own AI tools to help them navigate interviews, sometimes without employers knowing. With Chakra, HackerRank is betting AI can change not only how interviews are conducted, but also what employers can measure. Beyond whether someone arrives at the right answer, the startup wants to assess harder-to-capture signals such as critical thinking and judgment, as well as what it calls “AI fluency” — how well a candidate frames a problem for AI, judges its output, and steers it toward a solution. “The previous modality of evaluation was evaluating the output,” HackerRank co-founder and CEO Vivek Ravisankar said in an interview. “Now, because of AI, anybody can produce an artifact.” The question for employers, he said, becomes whether they can understand the thinking and judgment that went into producing it. In practice, a Chakra interview is designed to look more like doing the job than taking a traditional coding test. A candidate gets a task involving a real-world code repository, and they work through it in a canvas that includes an AI assistant. As the candidate works, Chakra can use the context of what they are doing to ask follow-up questions, such as why they chose one approach over another, or how their solution would change if a new constraint were introduced. Ravisankar told TechCrunch that Chakra is changing the basic structure of the hiring process itself. What previously involved three separate rounds, comprising a recruiter screen, take-home assessment, and follow-up interview with an engineer, is now combined into a single Chakra interview, he said. Giving candidates access to AI during an interview might seem to make it easier to cheat. However, HackerRank says it found the opposite. Suspicious-activity flags, Ravisankar said, were 70% to 80% lower in Chakra interviews than in comparable traditional HackerRank assessments, though the rate varied depending on factors such as geography and seniority. Ravisankar told TechCrunch that giving candidates access to AI reduces the incentive to secretly use outside tools that can feed them answers during an interview. Launched at TechCrunch Disrupt in 2012, HackerRank built its business around coding challenges, eventually helping companies assess and hire developers based on their technical skills. The Y Combinator-backed startup now has more than 3,000 business customers, including Amazon, Nvidia, Clay, and Replit, and a community of over 30 million developers worldwide. Chakra represents a bet against the kind of technical assessment business HackerRank spent years building. Its traditional product largely tested whether developers could solve coding problems correctly. Nonetheless, Ravisankar believes AI has made HackerRank’s earlier model less useful to measure engineering ability. Ravisankar compared the transition internally to Apple moving from the iPod to the iPhone, as the old product still has value, but the new one represents where the startup believes the market is headed. “Chakra is going to be the headline,” he said. “It’s going to be the way that we’re going to move forward.”

articles.title: OpenAI launches visual ads that appear alongside image generation results | TechCrunch
articles.summary: OpenAI said the new visual ads will show up after your image generation results appear in the U.S. only for now.
articles.body_text: ChatGPT is getting more ads. Specifically, OpenAI is adding visual display ads to its ad product line-up so that ads will appear alongside images that users ask ChatGPT to generate. In addition, the company is expanding its ad measurement tools and partnerships, and developing new ways to determine brand suitability. The new ads will begin to appear later this month in the U.S. only for now, and will feature products and services from an initial test group of advertisers. The ads will also be clearly labeled and won’t influence the answers ChatGPT provides, the company notes. The move follows the launch of Meta’s Muse, an agentic AI app which is free to everyone and a growing competitor for leading AI chatbots, like ChatGPT. OpenAI introduced ads earlier this year to support its free and low-cost subscription tiers, and expanded them to India in August. Now, the plan is to woo online advertisers who want to appeal to their potential customers by using more visual imagery to tell their stories. Eventually, those ads will allow them to target ChatGPT’s 1.2 billion weekly users, once they roll out globally. However, integrating such ads could also prove disruptive to the user experience. But perhaps that’s partly the point, as the ads could push more casual users to pay for a subscription in order to avoid them. Alongside the display ads, OpenAI said it is expanding its measurement tools and partner ecosystem, which now includes click attribution solutions, AppsFlyer, Triple Whale, Adjust, DV Rockerbox, Northbeam, Branch, Singular, Kochava, Airbridge, and Tenjin, as well as full-funnel, advanced measurement partners Fospha, Measured, and INCRMNTAL. OpenAI has also partnered with Haus, Measured, and WorkMagic to help advertisers explore “geo-based” experiments around ads. The company said it’s working on developing brand suitability evaluation pilots with help from DoubleVerify (DV) and Integral Ad Science (IAS), which will help advertisers better understand the ChatGPT ads environment. Combined, the moves see OpenAI working to make ChatGPT a viable ad-supported business for those on free and low-cost plans.
